candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly for Hindi text written in the Devanagari script, particularly common consonantal syllables and standalone vowel signs.
This vector represents fragments of Hindi words and characters encoded in a multilingual tokenizer.
These tokens represent Hindi syllables and consonant-vowel conjuncts commonly used in Devanagari script.
These tokens represent common subword fragments and characters frequently used in Hindi text encoding.
This vector represents character n-grams and subword components characteristic of Hindi text encoding.
This vector activates on Hindi words and suffixes that feature the vowel sign "ा" combined with various following consonants and vowels.
This feature vector represents common Devanagari consonant-vowel conjuncts and syllabic prefixes in Hindi.
This vector represents common Hindi word suffixes and morphological endings.
They represent Devanagari vowel matras and consonant-vowel combinations combined with punctuation marks.
This vector activates on various Hindi vowel-sign matras and punctuation marks attached to commas.
